column6: The signature block explicitly gives the signing date as 31 January 2023 (31 كانون الثاني 2023), which also fits chronologically between neighbouring numbers 3025 (2023-01-10) and 3027 (2023-02-15).

The signature_block explicitly dates the signing to 26 June 2023 (26 حزيران 2023), showing a one-digit month typo in printed_signed and placing signing after the latest preamble date (2023-06-23) and 10 days before printed_gazette_date.
